# Paper Lab

> A modern academic report editor built for students and researchers.

## Overview
Paper Lab is a platform that features a full LaTeX engine, priority cloud compiles, and a WYSIWYG diagram editor.

## Key Features
- **Full LaTeX Engine**: Write documents with the power and flexibility of LaTeX.
- **Priority Cloud Compiles**: Fast and reliable document generation in the cloud.
- **WYSIWYG Diagram Editor**: Create diagrams visually and embed them seamlessly into your reports.

## Official Resources
- **Website**: [Paper Lab](https://paperlab.r3actr.work)
